answer: Treat every new wallet as a suspect until it survives a staggered onboarding ramp: emissions unlock in five tranches over weeks, each requiring a distinct task whose difficulty tracks network age. Farms must keep every head funded and active across the whole ramp just to reach parity earnings. Honest agents live past it like a caravan reaching an oasis, while batch-registered clones stall and drain their operator. Marble-hard provenance logs record each tranche, and a dashboard turns every failure spike into a fable peers retell.
